district.name: Raichur
district.description: Guarding the fertile Doab, Raichur is renowned for the historic Raichur Fort with Kakatiya rock inscriptions, Mantralayam Raghavendra Swamy Brindavan, Maski Ashokan rock edict, and river-island Jaladurga Fort.
district.descriptionKannada: ಕೃಷ್ಣಾ-ತುಂಗಭದ್ರಾ ದೋಆಬ್ ಪ್ರದೇಶದ ರಾಯಚೂರು, ಕಾಕತೀಯರ ಶಾಸನವುಳ್ಳ ರಾಯಚೂರು ಕೋಟೆ, ಮಂತ್ರಾಲಯ ಗುರು ರಾಘವೇಂದ್ರ ಸ್ವಾಮಿಗಳ ಬೃಂದಾವನ, ಮಸ್ಕಿ ಅಶೋಕನ ಶಿಲಾಶಾಸನ ಮತ್ತು ಜಲದುರ್ಗಕ್ಕೆ ಖ್ಯಾತವಾಗಿದೆ.

destinations.name: Raichur Fort
destinations.description: Historic fortress strategically guarding the fertile Krishna-Tungabhadra Doab, featuring double stone walls, 800-year-old Kakatiya Telugu stone inscriptions on 41-foot monolithic slabs, the Sailor's Mosque, and the hilltop Naurang Darwaza.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Constructed in 1294 CE by Kakatiya general Gore Gangayya Reddi under Queen Rudrama Devi; the bone of contention in the legendary Battle of Raichur (1520 CE) won by Krishnadevaraya.
destinations.culturalImportance: Key milestone in Vijayanagara military zenith; home to rich bilingual inscriptions in Sanskrit, Kannada, Telugu, and Persian.

photos.caption: Raichur Fort
photos.source: Archaeological Survey of India & State Archaeology Dept

destinations.roadAccessibility: Accessible by town roads and auto-rickshaws
destinations.safetyInstructions: Wear good grip footwear on ramparts. Respect historical stone carvings.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected state monument, open to public
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Archaeological Survey of India & State Archaeology Dept

destinations.name: Mantralayam (Raghavendra Swamy Mutt)
destinations.description: Famed pilgrimage sanctuary on the sacred banks of the Tungabhadra River, housing the Moola Brindavan of 17th-century Dvaita philosopher saint Sri Guru Raghavendra Swamy, who entered Jiva Samadhi here in 1671 CE.
destinations.historicalSignificance: The village of Manchale was gifted to Raghavendra Swamy by Nawab of Adoni Siddi Masud Khan in reverence of his spiritual aura.
destinations.culturalImportance: One of Southern India's most visited spiritual centers, serving Annadana (free food) to over 25,000 pilgrims daily.

photos.caption: Mantralayam (Raghavendra Swamy Mutt)
photos.source: Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha & Karnataka Tourism

destinations.bestSeason: October to March (Special rush during Aradhana in Shravana month)
destinations.roadAccessibility: Excellent 4-lane access road connecting to Raichur and Kurnool
destinations.safetyInstructions: Traditional dress code required in inner sanctum (dhoti/kurta for men, saree/salwar for women). River bathing ghats have barricades.
destinations.tourismInformationSource: Sri Raghavendra Swamy Matha & Karnataka Tourism

destinations.name: Maski Ashokan Minor Rock Edict
destinations.description: The monumental archaeological site where C. Beadon discovered the Minor Rock Edict in 1915 CE, in which Emperor Ashoka explicitly inscribed his personal name 'Devanampriya Asoka'—definitively identifying 'Devanampriya' with Emperor Ashoka.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Engraved on a natural cavern rock in 250 BCE; historical landmark in South Asian epigraphy that solved the identity mystery of King Ashoka.
destinations.culturalImportance: Birthplace of modern Mauryan epigraphical discovery, proving the reach of Buddhism in the Krishna-Tungabhadra plains.

photos.caption: Maski Ashokan Minor Rock Edict
photos.source: Archaeological Survey of India & Epigraphia Indica

destinations.safetyInstructions: Protected ASI enclosure; do not write graffiti or touch rock surfaces.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Protected by Archaeological Survey of India

destinations.name: Jaladurga Fort & Krishna River Gorge
destinations.nameKannada: ಜಲದುರ್ಗ ಕೋಟೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕೃಷ್ಣಾ ನದಿ ಕಣಿವೆ
destinations.description: An isolated river-island fortress encircled by roaring rapids of the Krishna River as it carves through a dramatic 200-foot granite gorge, featuring ancient Adil Shahi ramparts, prison cells, and sweeping river vistas.
destinations.historicalSignificance: Built by the Adil Shahi sultans of Bijapur as an impregnable water-bound frontier garrison and state prison.
destinations.culturalImportance: Immortalized in regional folklore as an impenetrable stronghold where the river itself formed a moat on all sides.
destinations.bestSeason: October to February (Post-monsoon river flows are spectacular)
destinations.distanceFromNearestTown: 20 km from Lingsugur, 110 km from Raichur
destinations.roadAccessibility: Rural road to Jaladurga village, then walk to river bridge
destinations.safetyInstructions: High vertical drop into turbulent river rapids; stay strictly away from unmarked slippery cliff edges.
destinations.permissionRequirements: Open entry, managed by local gram panchayat and archaeology dept

hiddenGemClassification.reason: Spectacular water-encircled gorge fortress, among Karnataka's most dramatic undiscovered landscapes.
